subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 2nd day of the 2nd tenday of Myrtul.
source_quote: 2nd day of the 2nd tenday of Myrtul

subject: derro count
fact: Five Derro are chanting.
source_quote: five Derro are chanting

subject: ettin count
fact: An Ettin is present next to the obvious boss.
source_quote: an Ettin .

subject: stone giant statue height
fact: The statue of a stone giant with a second head emerging from it is only 2 feet tall.
source_quote: it is only 2 feet tall

subject: summoning ritual effect
fact: They are performing some kind of summoning ritual to make the Stone Giants sprout a second head.
source_quote: They are performing some kind of summoning ritual to make the Stone Giants sprout a second head.

subject: ritual chant origin
fact: The ritual chant was taken from the book in the chief cultist's hands.
source_quote: the book in the chief cultist's hands.

subject: ritual chant content
fact: The chant includes: 'Hear me, you two-headed fools! His madness flows, our city drools! From Whorlstone's depths, the spirals turn! For Demogorgon, the city will burn! More heads for grafting! More for the pile! Gracklstugh trembles, defiled.'
source_quote: “Hear me, you two-headed fools! His madness flows, our city drools! From Whorlstone's depths, the spirals turn! For Demogorgon, the city will burn! More heads for grafting! More for the pile! Gracklstugh trembles, defiled

subject: cultist cavern location
fact: The cultist cavern is located outside of Buppido’s lair.
source_quote: outside of the cultist cavern

subject: ritual failure condition
fact: The ritual will not work if the Derro cannot say their lines with fervor.
source_quote: the ritual will not work if we can’t say our lines. And with fervor.

subject: ritual chant variation
fact: The chant includes: 'Two heads! Two heads! A glorious sight! The Deepking falls into endless night! Narrak's vision, sharp and keen! The Prince of Chaos, always unseen!'
source_quote: Two heads! Two heads! A glorious sight! The Deepking falls into endless night! Narrak's vision, sharp and keen! The Prince of Chaos, always unseen!

subject: darkness effect zone
fact: Zalthir’s magical darkness envelops the Derro and obscures Narrak’s vision.
source_quote: all the derro are covered in his magical darkness

subject: fear spell effect
fact: Narrak uses a white feather to cast fear on Thorin, Grygum, and Zalthir, causing them to become terrified.
source_quote: says the magic words, and the three members of the Ember Vanguard look terrified.

subject: fear dispelling method
fact: Zalthir moves the darkness over Narrak, removing the source of fear and dispelling its effect.
source_quote: He moves the darkness over Narrak. As the source of the Ember Vanguard’s fear is no longer visible, they are no longer affected by it.

subject: acid vomit spell
fact: Grygum vomits forth a wave of acid after a violent heaving.
source_quote: vomits forth a wave of acid

subject: scorching rays spell
fact: Daz casts three spears of flame, raging hues of orange and red, toward the Ettin.
source_quote: Three spears of flame, raging hues of orange and red, appear above me... I hurl them toward the Ettin .

subject: maximillian’s earthen grasp spell
fact: Daz casts Maximillian’s Earthen Grasp on where he thinks Narrak is.
source_quote: I cast Maximillian’s Earthen Grasp on where I think he is.

subject: curse spreading claim
fact: Narrak claims, 'You cannot stop the inevitable... the curse spreads!'
source_quote: You cannot stop the inevitable... the curse spreads!

subject: final resting place
fact: The final resting place is Buppido’s lair, a grim place full of dead bones and an altar to some demonic power.
source_quote: We are once again at the final resting place of Buppido. It’s a grim place, full of dead bones, and an altar to some demonic power or some mad idea.

subject: myconid communication method
fact: The Myconid communicates through spores, allowing silent communication in certain tactical situations.
source_quote: The spores allow us to communicate in certain tactical situations silently

subject: zombie conversion process
fact: The Myconids have a process that allows them to convert their dead enemies into zombies.
source_quote: we have this process that allows us to convert our dead enemies into zombies.

subject: knot wager
fact: JimJar bets Grygum that his knots won’t hold on Pelek/Derro.
source_quote: He bets me that my knots won’t hold.

subject: death as sleep debate
fact: Pelek/Derro muses on whether death is a form of sleep.
source_quote: There is this whole question about whether death is a form of sleep.

subject: derro distraction target
fact: A Derro is preoccupied with a death dog, desperately trying hard not to be noticed.
source_quote: preoccupied with a death dog, desperately trying hard not to be noticed

subject: narrak’s leadership style
fact: Narrak behaves like a choir director, demanding vigor and passion in ritual chanting.
source_quote: like every choir director ever shouts, 'Silence, you blithering half-wits! More vigor!'

subject: derro avoidance behavior
fact: A Derro avoids being seen by Narrak, as high-level clerics can kill easily.
source_quote: He’s trying to avoid being seen by Narrak... A high-level cleric can kill you very easily.
